goal: Deliver the reviewed Unity Transport 2.6 adapter from the Game.Packages repository with bounded connections, exact channel mapping and deterministic native ownership.
acceptance: Package com.unigame.staticecs.network.utp implements INetworkTransport without changing the core package
ReliableOrdered uses fragmentation plus reliable sequenced and is bounded to 64 KiB
UnreliableSequenced uses the unreliable sequenced pipeline and is bounded by MaximumUnreliableBytes
TrySend always consumes its lease and TryReceive transfers an exact NetworkBufferPool lease
Client connect and server listen/accept/disconnect are bounded and exception-safe
Focused tests cover both channel round trips, receive ownership, maximum connections, stale accepts, overflow and failed construction

workspace.reason: Historical workspace; current squashed package head contains the accepted adapter.

execution.handoff: Historical R2 adapter is integrated in the current package head and its lease is closed before NETWORK-ECS-FIRST-V5.
validationEvidence: package JSON and asmdef files parse

riskToTest: lease ownership -> rejected-send and loopback receive lease tests
channel mapping -> reliable and unreliable exact-boundary loopback tests
connection bounds -> maximum-connections and stale-accept tests
